content.comment_body: I'm working on a school project that requires using a shift register. The simulation in the programming environment runs as expected, but when I try to download the program to the automation device, I encounter an error message (see attached image). My understanding is that with the shift register, I should be able to connect the selected bit to an output. I selected S1 and tried various outputs like Q, M, and X, but none of them functioned correctly. Does anyone have any suggestions?
Could you please upload your program as a zip archive?
This current release uses X as the output.
I'm not very familiar with ladder logic usually... You need to use a make contact and select SF001 instead of S1.1. Check the attachment for details.
